walk.rationale: Restore moving contact, loading and passing drawings. Only29 and42 remain omitted;28/41 hold the nearly fully extended foot for two ticks.27-tick source cycle remains unchanged. Torso-angle drift is inherited source motion, not repaired by frame selection.

run.rationale: Restore52,56,60,64: all four source intermediates move limbs substantially; a two-tick hold then jump damages the fast16-tick cadence. Keep every original source run drawing.

jump.rationale: Original39-tick anticipation, takeoff, flight, landing and upright recovery. Do not loop the old cropped107-to87 crouch seam. After121, automatic idle or pending requested action. Original tiny apex scalp clipping stays disclosed.

celebrate.rationale: Keep low and high settled poses held3ticks, but restore all arm rise/lower drawings71,73,79,81, avoiding large angular jumps. Arms remain raised even at the lowest source pose; no true standing-to-celebrate bridge exists.
